en: A monochrome postcard view of a waterfront in a small northern town. In the foreground are rocky shallows and several wooden rowing boats pulled up on the shore. On the right stands a distinctive wooden building with a tall square tower and a steep metal roof, with a few smaller houses behind it. Across the water more wooden sheds or boathouses line the opposite shore. The sky is cloudy and the overall scene has an early‑20th‑century feel. At the top of the postcard is printed text in Finnish.
